title: potentilla reptans var. ramosa
intro: Potentilla reptans var. ramosa, commonly known as creeping cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, wounds, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of creeping cinquefoil include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
